title: Rutgers Stat PhD Qual Question
description: A single transcribed question (or multi-part problem) from a Rutgers Statistics PhD qualifying exam.

level.description: Which qualifying exam this came from: the first-year PhD qual or the MS comprehensive exam.

part.description: Which part of the qual this came from.

number.description: Problem number as printed on the exam.

prompt.description: The full problem statement, Markdown + LaTeX (use $...$ / $$...$$).

parts.description: Optional list of sub-parts (a), (b), ... if you want them itemized.

solution.description: Optional worked solution (Markdown + LaTeX). null/omit if not transcribed.

data.description: Optional dataset files the problem depends on (applied/take-home exams). Repo-relative paths when the file is committed, or a bare filename + note when the dataset was not distributed with the PDF.

pdf.description: Path under exams/pdfs/ this was transcribed from.

verified.description: Whether a human has checked the transcription against the source PDF.

notes.description: Any transcriber notes (ambiguities, OCR issues, etc.).
